title: Crocolisk
wikitext:
[[image:crocolisk.png|thumb|]]

Long-snouted reptile with six short legs and a long tail. Crawls low to the ground, more like a [[snake|snake]] than a [[raptor|raptor]]. Usually found near water, as it swims skillfully.  They appear to be related to the primitive [[Diemetradon]]s.  Found in the [[Wailing Caverns]], [[Durotar]], [[Loch Modan]], the [[Wetlands]], the [[Swamp of Sorrows]], [[Dustwallow Marsh]], [[Zul'Gurub]], and even [[Stormwind]] (as the elusive sewer beast).   

==  As A [[Hunter]] Pet ==
* Have high armor, medium damage and low HP.
* Eats only Meat and Fish.
* Can learn [[Cower]], [[Bite]], and [[Cower]].  Crocolisks have yet to get their unique pet skill.
* Not very popular as a hunter pet.
